description: This file contains the implementation of the Gmac class, which provides cryptographic functionality related to Galois Message Authentication Code (GMAC) used in AES-GCM encryption. It includes methods to update data, finalize the authentication tag, and internal cryptographic operations.

classes.name: Gmac
classes.description: A class implementing the GMAC cryptographic algorithm for AES-GCM, supporting data updates and finalization of authentication tags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Gmac instance with a given AES key, nonce, and key size, setting up internal buffers and cryptographic states.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the GMAC state with additional data blocks, processing them for authentication.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes data processing to produce the authentication tag based on the accumulated data.

methods.name: bit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from a ByteArray at a given index.

methods.name: blockMultiply
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of two ByteArrays, essential for cryptographic calculations in GMAC.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Processes any remaining data in the buffer to update the authentication state.
